name: Pexip
description_en:
Pexip separates secure meeting hosting from room interoperability. Secure Meetings addresses controlled meeting environments; Connect bridges room devices with platforms such as Teams, Zoom and Google Meet; Engage is an appointment product. A capability of one should not automatically populate every Pexip plan.

The key integration question is the complete path from an existing room endpoint and invitation to the host meeting, including layout, content sharing, authentication and management.
description_zh:
Pexip 区分安全会议托管与会议室互通。Secure Meetings 面向受控会议环境，Connect 把会议室设备与 Teams、Zoom、Google Meet 等连接，Engage 是预约产品，不能把一项能力填入所有 Pexip 套餐。

集成重点是从现有会议室终端和邀请，到主办会议的完整路径，包括布局、内容共享、认证及管理。

core_features.explanation_en: Bridge specified room systems and SIP/H.323 endpoints into supported meeting platforms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将指定会议室及 SIP/H.323 终端接入支持的平台。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans describe SaaS/on-prem/private cloud and diagnostics, with scope-dependent options.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐介绍 SaaS/本地/私有云及诊断，具体选项依范围。

en: Inventory the room endpoint, codecs/control panel, host platform and invitation format. Select the appropriate Connect route and demonstrate join, content share and meeting controls. Support for one meeting type does not prove every breakout, lobby or dual-screen behavior on another host. No endpoint or tenant was configured.
zh: 盘点房间终端、编解码/控制面板、主办平台及邀请格式，选择适当 Connect 路径并演示加入、共享和会议控制。支持一种会议不证明另一主办平台上的分组、等候室或双屏都相同。本次未配置终端或租户。

sections.title_en: Example: join an external Teams meeting from a room
sections.title_zh: 示例：从会议室加入外部 Teams 会议
sections.en:
Inventory the room endpoint, codecs/control panel, host platform and invitation format. Select the appropriate Connect route and demonstrate join, content share and meeting controls. Support for one meeting type does not prove every breakout, lobby or dual-screen behavior on another host. No endpoint or tenant was configured.

Test a guest-hosted invitation and a rejected authentication, and inspect the diagnostic record before changing the room configuration.
sections.zh:
盘点房间终端、编解码/控制面板、主办平台及邀请格式，选择适当 Connect 路径并演示加入、共享和会议控制。支持一种会议不证明另一主办平台上的分组、等候室或双屏都相同。本次未配置终端或租户。

应测试外部主办邀请及认证拒绝，修改会议室配置前检查诊断记录。

sections.title_en: Product, room and deployment scope need a quote
sections.title_zh: 产品、会议室及部署范围需报价
sections.en:
The read Connect plans offer selection/help and sales paths rather than numeric prices. They describe features such as host-platform interoperability, One-Touch Join, authentication and analytics. Leave amounts blank; establish licensed endpoints/rooms, platform subscriptions, deployment compute, support and additional services in the offer.

SaaS, private cloud and customer-hosted infrastructure are explicit options in parts of the plan table, not universal inclusions. Self-hosting a licensed platform does not make it open source or remove upgrade, capacity and recovery work.
sections.zh:
已读 Connect 套餐提供选型/销售入口，没有数字价格。它介绍平台互通、One-Touch Join、认证及分析，金额留空；应在报价中明确终端/会议室、平台订阅、计算资源、支持及附加服务。

SaaS、私有云及客户托管基础设施是表格部分方案的明确选项，不是通用包含。许可平台自托管不等于开源，也不会消除升级、容量及恢复工作。

sections.title_en: Separate interoperability acceptance from security assurance
sections.title_zh: 区分互通验收与安全保证
sections.en:
Organizations retaining room hardware across platforms can evaluate Connect; sensitive meeting hosts should assess Secure Meetings separately. Prepare network/firewall, certificate, identity and operational requirements with the vendor instead of assuming a download completes deployment.

No call quality, cross-platform compatibility, access control, contract licence, load, data residency or recovery was tested. Defense/healthcare examples are vendor positioning and not proof that the buyer’s configured workflow meets its requirements.
sections.zh:
希望跨平台保留会议室硬件的组织可评估 Connect，敏感会议主办者应另评 Secure Meetings。应与厂商准备网络/防火墙、证书、身份和运营要求，不能认为下载即完成部署。

未测试通话质量、跨平台兼容、访问控制、合同许可、负载、驻留或恢复。国防/医疗示例是厂商定位，不证明买家配置符合要求。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Exact SKU/room count, host-platform dependency, deployment/licence, pricing, compatibility and recovery require vendor/account tests.
research_gaps.zh: 具体 SKU/房间数、平台依赖、部署/许可、价格、兼容及恢复需厂商/账户测试。
